properties.name: ML-KEM-1024 (Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(k^2 * n log n) polynomial ring operations, n=256, k=4

properties.name: Inverse Number Theoretic Transform (iNTT over Z_3329)
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(N log N) modular multiplications; Space: O(N), N=256
properties.algorithm_variant: Gentleman-Sande butterfly radix-2 network with Barrett modular reduction

properties.name: ARM Scalable Vector Extension 2 (SVE2 / FEAT_SVE2)
properties.throughput_bounds: Vector Length Agnostic (128-2048 bits), processing 16x 16-bit lanes per 256-bit SIMD block

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Signed saturating doubling multiply returning high half across active 16-bit vector lanes in Zn and Zm under predicate Pg
Multiply elements in Zn and Zm and accumulate into Zda for 16-bit modular lane arithmetic under predicate Pg

properties.alignment_requirement: Implementation defined vector length boundary alignment (min 128-bit)

properties.operation: Converts polynomial vectors back from transform domain in decapsulation/encapsulation steps

properties.vector_width: Scalable lane processing of 16-bit ring coefficients per SVE vector register length

properties.stage: High-half fixed-point product evaluation in Montgomery/Barrett reduction butterfly step
Multiply-accumulate stage in Gentleman-Sande inverse butterfly network

properties.access_pattern: Predicated read/write operation over scalable 16-bit word lanes in Z0-Z31 registers
Predicated accumulation into scalable vector registers holding ring polynomial coefficients
